in this repository under `cards/<finding ID>/`. Nothing here is invented or edited; the SHA-256
of each copy equals the one in that card's `MANIFEST.json`. ANT-2026-CN7KX43N (fix link is an NVD
page) is already frozen in `tests/fixtures/withheld-cards/` and is used from there.
